findings.title: A bare `status: null` frame settles a running compaction as "stopped"
findings.body: The branch at 7141-7142 treats any `status: null` frame with no `compact_result` and no `permissionMode` as the end of compaction. When `context.compaction` is running, that frame marks it `interrupted` (7157) with the title "Context compaction stopped" (7163). Does the Claude SDK ever send a bare `status: null` before the `compact_result` frame, or alongside other state changes? If it does, a compaction that succeeds would show as stopped for the moment before the success frame. The success frame would then find `context.compaction` already `null` (7172), so the row would stay "stopped". The fixtures `claude_compact_after_peer_turn` and `claude_compact_after_resume_wake` only show the compacting, success, boundary order, with `compact_result` on the null frame. No test or fixture covers a bare `null`.

findings.title: A boundary reuses a stale "completed" compaction held after a success status
findings.body: After a `compact_result: "success"` frame, `context.compaction` stays set with status `completed` until a boundary clears it (7172 only clears it for non-success). `finalizeActiveTurn` clears it at turn end (6071). Within a single turn, a later boundary-only compaction, such as the manual boundary the test sends at line 4576, would be merged into the earlier item. It would reuse that item's id and ordinal, and `completedAt` would keep the old time (7260). That would overwrite the earlier row instead of adding a new one. Consider reusing `context.compaction` only while its status is `completed` and it has no `afterTokenCount`, or keying the reuse on the same compaction.

findings.title: New `isCompacting` predicate has no test on web or mobile
findings.body: The new running-compaction path, which also makes automatic compaction disable steering and show the "Compacting…" label, is only covered at the adapter level. The settled-status set (`completed`/`failed`/`interrupted`/`cancelled`) is copied by hand in `ChatView.tsx:2521-2524` and `apps/mobile/src/state/use-thread-composer-state.ts:357-360`. Web gates on `activeRuntime?.activeRunId` for the running check but on `activeActivityRun?.runId` for the settled check. The two clients could drift. A small shared pure helper in `packages/client-runtime` with a test would cover both.

findings.title: Compaction status-to-label mapping is now duplicated
findings.body: This PR adds the failed and stopped labels to `contextCompactionLabel` in `packages/client-runtime/src/work-log/presentation.ts:70-72`. `V2LifecycleRow.tsx` already carries its own copy of the same mapping, and `MessagesTimeline.tsx:2942` still uses a fixed "Context compacted" label. Any later wording change has to be made in several places. This is only cleanup.

contracts.action: Claude adapter emits a running compaction item on `status: "compacting"` and settles the same item on status result, boundary, or turn finalization
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous path created the compaction item only at `compact_boundary`, with a derived id and ordinal from the boundary uuid, and emitted it once as completed.
contracts.before_after: Before: one completed `turn_item.updated` at the boundary. After: a running item at the compacting status. It is settled at the compact_result status frame, at the boundary (which adds token counts), or at `finalizeActiveTurn` (6055-6071) when the turn ends first. The item id is now derived from the status uuid when a status precedes the boundary. The fixtures only assert before/after token counts, not ids.
contracts.visible_effect: Automatic compaction shows "Compacting context" while it runs. It then shows the completed label, with token counts once the boundary arrives. Failed or stopped compactions show "Context compaction failed" or "Context compaction stopped".
contracts.failure_mode: If the turn ends or the query exits mid-compaction, `finalizeActiveTurn` emits a failed or stopped update, so the row is not left running; tests at ClaudeAdapterV2.test.ts:4714-4786 cover this. A bare `status: null` could mark a successful compaction as stopped, and a stale completed item could be reused by a later boundary (see findings).

contracts.action: Web and mobile treat a running compaction item in the active run as `isCompacting`, and treat failed, interrupted and cancelled items as settled
contracts.equivalent_path: The `/compact` command-message detection, which this PR keeps as a fallback in both clients.
contracts.before_after: Before: only a `/compact` user message could set `isCompacting`, and only a `completed` item settled it. After: a running item in the active run sets it directly, and any terminal item status settles the `/compact` path.
contracts.visible_effect: The "Compacting…" working label and the shimmer on the compaction row now appear for automatic compaction. Steering is blocked on mobile (`canSteerActiveTurn`) while it runs.
contracts.failure_mode: A running item that is never settled keeps `isCompacting` true only while the phase is running/connecting (web) or the run is active (mobile). The adapter settles unfinished items at turn end, so the state does not persist.

summary: The change is sound overall. The adapter emits a running compaction item on the `compacting` status and settles the same item at the success status, at the boundary, or when the turn ends. `finalizeActiveTurn` settles an unfinished item before the terminal event, and the new tests cover that. The web and mobile `isCompacting` changes and the new labels look consistent. Findings are minor. One asks whether a bare `status: null` frame can mark a successful compaction as \"stopped\". One flags that a boundary can reuse a stale completed item. Two are about the missing client test and the duplicated label mapping. I did not run any tests.
